    src=open(f'more_itertools/{mod}.py').read()
    stub=open(f'more_itertools/{mod}.pyi').read()
    names=set(ast.literal_eval(re.search(r'__all__ = (\[.*?\])',src,re.S).group(1)))

    print(mod,'in __all__ not in stub:',sorted(names-sn))

E
